newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end moderately higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end moderately higher.

text.p: Oct 23 - U.S. stock index futures rose late, ended moderately higher. Traders tied rise partly to technical resilience after morning's drop that forced shorts to cover and drew fresh buying. Some noted dealer buying plus signs of arb buy programs late after NYSE lifted curb. Some said recovery could cajole would-be longs back into market, support more gains. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
